summary.text: Les Farnum is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives representing District 33, which the legislature's member page lists as covering Calcasieu Parish. First elected in 2019, Les Farnum sits on the House and Governmental Affairs, Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs, and Ways and Means committees and the House Executive Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists Les Farnum's occupation as division manager at PCS2000, with an education at Sulphur High School and Sowela Technical School.

The House page lists Les Farnum's committee assignments as House and Governmental Affairs, Municipal, Parochial and Cultural Affairs, Ways and Means, House Executive Committee, and Joint Legislative Committee on Capital Outlay, and caucus and delegation affiliations as Acadiana Delegation, Louisiana Republican Legislative Delegation, and Louisiana Rural Caucus.
